entities.summary: Rafi Haladjian is a French entrepreneur of Armenian origin known for his work in early internet services and connected devices. He co-founded FranceNet, one of France's first Internet service providers, and is the co-creator of the Nabaztag, a WiFi enabled device associated with the development of Internet of Things technologies. Rafi Haladjian was a performers & entertainers from Beirut (b. 1961-06-08, Beirut). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
